title: Mixed LEFM enriched-shape row request

local_point_from_tip_m.description: Exact local crack-frame query relative to the tip; use this to preserve y=0 for explicit branch-face traces in a rotated frame.

source_ids.description: Stable IDs aligned row-wise with the base arrays; output rows are sorted by ID.

base_values.description: Dimensionless base shape N_i, one per source_id.

base_gradients_world_per_m.description: World-frame analytic gradient of N_i, one per source_id.

axes_world_from_local.description: 3x3 row-major Q; columns are local crack axes expressed in world xyz. Must be proper orthonormal with determinant +1.

branch_trace.description: Required only when the local point is exactly x<0,y=0; selects theta=+pi or -pi.

$comment: Supply either point_world_m plus tip_world_m or local_point_from_tip_m, never both. base_values and base_gradients_world_per_m must each have exactly len(source_ids) rows. Frame orthonormality, proper orientation, finite values, exact-cut trace requirements, and front singularity are checked by the implementation.
